articles.title: Kalshi turns to small businesses as legal battles threaten forecasts on sports
articles.snippet: The prediction market is pitching protection against tariffs, weather and other business risks as courts challenge its ability to offer sports wagers.

articles.title: Bitcoin on course to end seven-week losing streak while trailing stock rebound
articles.snippet: Bitcoin (BTC) has risen 1.8% since midnight UTC to around $61,600 and is on course to end seven straight weekly losses.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin's Thanksgiving gains prove fleeting
articles.snippet: Stocks are broadly higher, but bitcoin has slipped back near $60,000, reversing a turkey day advance.

articles.title: Next ECB chief favors tokenized bank deposits over stablecoins and bitcoin
articles.snippet: Pablo Hernández de Cos, chosen to succeed Christine Lagarde, favors blockchain-based banking and has warned against private digital currencies and banks holding bitcoin.

articles.title: Tether can freeze stolen crypto in minutes. Getting it back can take years.
articles.snippet: Tether says it has returned $1.28 billion in frozen USDT, but victims can wait years to recover their money and face fees of up to 20%.
